## a11y

### media-fallbacks  (library: fw-a11y-media-fallbacks)
- tier: recipe
- what: Adds reduced-transparency, more-contrast and reduced-motion fallbacks for the glass and relief surfaces.
- params: ring (bool, default true)

## art

### duotone-plate  (library: duotone-ink)
- tier: generator
- what: Art generator: a duotone cover plate mixed from the primary and ink, with halftone dots, grain and a giant initial.
- params: inkMix (number, default 0.35, 0..1); hiMix (number, default 0.3, 0..1); hiMixDark (number, default 0.4, 0..1); loMix (number, default 0.45, 0..1); loMixDark (number, default 0.25, 0..1); halftone (number, default 0.34, 0..1); halftoneDark (number, default 0.16, 0..1); dot (number, default 5, 2..20); grain (number, default 0.09, 0..0.4); initial (bool, default true); initialTone (number, default 0.72, 0..1); frame (bool, default true)
- hooks: art

### field-band  (library: geometric-fill)
- tier: generator
- what: Fills a band behind a section with a chosen pattern such as ripple, rays or check.
- params: palette (enum, default "ripple", ripple|rays|check|rings|none); type (enum, default "rays", ripple|rays|check|rings|none); ui (enum, default "check", ripple|rays|check|rings|none); touch (enum, default "check", ripple|rays|check|rings|none); use (enum, default "rings", ripple|rays|check|rings|none); opacity (number, default 0.2, 0.05..0.6); widthPct (number, default 55, 20..100)

### op-art-ripple  (library: op-art-ripple)
- tier: generator
- what: Art generator: concentric rings warped by an SVG turbulence displacement, set in a hard-edged frame.
- params: rings (number, default 26, 6..60); scale (number, default 34, 0..80); blur (number, default 4, 0..12); freqX (number, default 0.011, 0.001..0.05); freqY (number, default 0.008, 0.001..0.05); aspect (number, default 0.8, 0.5..1.5); border (number, default 2, 0..6); offset (number, default 5, 0..12); seed (number, default 7, 1..50); withArt (bool, default true)
- hooks: art

## colour

### canvas-ink-pull  (library: tinted-neutral-canvas)
- tier: recipe
- what: Mixes a small share of ink into the canvas so every surface sits a touch off the page colour, with separate amounts for light and dark.
- params: light (number, default 0.06, 0..0.3); dark (number, default 0.04, 0..0.3)
- hooks: canvas

### equal-luminance-clash  (library: equal-luminance-clash)
- tier: generator
- what: Computes a partner colour at near-equal luminance to the primary so the two vibrate edge to edge.
- params: offset (number, default 165, 60..300); chromaFloor (number, default 0.1, 0..0.3); chromaFloor2 (number, default 0.12, 0..0.3); chromaRescue (number, default 0.15, 0..0.3); greenFrom (number, default 95, 0..360); greenTo (number, default 200, 0..360); greenPartnerHue (number, default 340, 0..360); greenPartnerL (number, default 0.7, 0.3..0.98); darkBelow (number, default 0.45, 0..1); darkPartnerHue (number, default 128, 0..360); darkPartnerL (number, default 0.89, 0.3..0.98)

### fixed-lamp-cast
- tier: generator
- what: Casts one fixed lamp colour over canvas, ink, rules and muted text, independent of the client primary, plus an optional soft wash on the board.
- params: lamp (colour, default "#ff4a1f"); canvasMix (number, default 0.1, 0..0.4); inkMix (number, default 0.16, 0..0.5); wash (number, default 0.14, 0..0.5)

### full-bleed-hero-field  (library: flat-colour-planes)
- tier: recipe
- what: Fills the hero with a full-bleed pair-coloured field in the chosen mode.
- params: mode (enum, default "light", light|dark|both); kicker (enum, default "pair-b", pair-a|pair-b|ink)

### mono-plus-accent  (library: mono-plus-accent)
- tier: recipe
- what: Keeps colour to the accent word and one action; app screens fall back to ink and canvas.
- params: kitAccent (enum, default "ink", ink|accent); kitSecondary (enum, default "canvas", canvas|secondary); tintMix (number, default 6, 0..30); markWord (bool, default true); sign (text, default "§")

### muted-contrast-floor  (library: fw-contrast-fit)
- tier: generator
- what: Pushes the muted text colour toward ink until it holds a contrast ratio on the canvas and the lifted panel, and sets the on-rim colour.
- params: min (number, default 4.6, 3..7); onRim (number, default 0.45, 0..1); panelLift (number, default 0.1, 0..0.4)

### pair-colour-tints  (library: role-tint-fill)
- tier: token
- what: Derives tinted fills, text and shadow colours from the vibrating pair.
- params: tint (number, default 0.12, 0..0.5); liftTo (number, default 5, 3..8)

### paper-edge  (library: tonal-ramp)
- tier: token
- what: Colour move: derives one edge colour between canvas and ink and publishes it on ctx.bus (and as --ab-edge) for later moves.
- params: amount (number, default 0.7, 0.2..1)

### primary-reprint  (library: primary-reprint)
- tier: generator
- what: Re-prints the primary at a chosen saturation with lightness set by hue band; a muted primary falls back to a fixed lime.
- params: saturation (number, default 100, 0..100); bandFrom (number, default 52, 0..360); bandTo (number, default 170, 0..360); band2To (number, default 285, 0..360); lightBand (number, default 50, 20..80); lightBand2 (number, default 58, 20..80); lightOther (number, default 54, 20..80); mutedBelow (number, default 24, 0..60); fallback (colour, default "#B6FF00")
- hooks: printPrimary

### relief-pair  (library: raised-relief)
- tier: generator
- what: Derives the shared highlight, shadow, rim and gloss tones from the canvas that every raised, recessed and glossy surface uses.
- params: hiLight (number, default 0.79, 0..1); hiDark (number, default 0.11, 0..1); loMix (number, default 0.25, 0..1); loAlpha (number, default 0.6, 0..1); loDark (number, default 0.53, 0..1); rimDark (number, default 0.06, 0..0.3); glossLight (number, default 0.5, 0..1); glossDark (number, default 0.07, 0..1)

### skyline-bars  (library: colour-bar-strip)
- tier: generator
- what: Builds a skyline bar strip in the pair colours for strips and meters.
- params: bars (number, default 10, 4..20); width (number, default 4, 1..10); step (number, default 6, 2..14); height (number, default 14, 6..40)

### state-colour-derivation  (library: fw-state-colour-derivation)
- tier: token
- what: Derives pressed and hover colours from the primary and ink.
- params: pressMix (number, default 0.78, 0..1); hoverMix (number, default 0.88, 0..1)

### tinted-neutral-canvas  (library: tinted-neutral-canvas)
- tier: recipe
- what: Canvas tinted from the primary hue at low saturation; light mode mixes toward a cream, dark mode a deep tint.
- params: tint (number, default 14, 0..40); paperMix (number, default 0.35, 0..1); cream (colour, default "#f4ecd8"); lightL (number, default 95, 85..100); darkL (number, default 11, 2..25)
- hooks: canvas

### warm-paper-canvas  (library: tinted-neutral-canvas)
- tier: recipe
- what: Warms the canvas toward a cream paper colour while keeping a share of the base.
- params: cream (colour, default "#f3ead9"); keep (number, default 0.74, 0..1); warmDark (bool, default false)
- hooks: canvas

## layout

### hero-layout  (library: hero-layout)
- tier: recipe
- what: Lays the hero out as headline beside a tall plate.
- params: plateMin (number, default 190, 100..400); plateVw (number, default 29, 10..50); plateMax (number, default 370, 200..700); gap (number, default 4.4, 1..10); aspect (text, default "3 / 4.15"); headlineVw (number, default 11.5, 5..20); leading (number, default 0.94, 0.8..1.3); tracking (number, default -0.028, -0.1..0.02); kickerRule (bool, default true); subRule (bool, default true)

### palette-board-form  (library: palette-board-form)
- tier: recipe
- what: Sets the palette as a ruled grid of chips.
- params: cols (number, default 5, 2..8); chip (number, default 18, 10..40)

## material

### arc-ring
- tier: recipe
- what: Material: a loading ring: a raised, faint track with one ink arc that turns.
- params: width (number, default 5, 2..10); arc (number, default 55, 10..100); track (number, default 10, 0..50); distance (number, default 2, 0..6); blur (number, default 5, 0..12)
- materials: arc-ring

### caps-key
- tier: recipe
- what: Material: a keyboard hint as small tracked caps in a hairline box.
- params: size (number, default 12, 9..16); tracking (number, default 0.08, 0..0.3)
- materials: caps-key

### caps-label-row  (library: caps-mono-labels)
- tier: recipe
- what: Material: a section label as tracked small caps with no rule of its own.
- params: tracking (number, default 0.18, 0..0.4); weight (number, default 600, 300..800)
- materials: caps-label-row

### caps-links  (library: caps-mono-labels)
- tier: recipe
- what: Material: navigation items as tracked small caps, optionally inside thick-over-thin rules, with the current item shown as italic, a bar, bold type or an ink fill.
- params: size (number, default 12, 8..16); tracking (number, default 0.14, 0..0.4); frame (enum, default "none", none|rule-pair|bottom); top (number, default 3, 1..8); current (enum, default "none", none|italic|bar-left|bar-bottom|bold|fill); bar (number, default 2, 1..4); items (enum, default "caps", caps|keep-face)
- materials: caps-links

### clear-glass  (library: clear-glass)
- tier: generator
- what: Material: see-through panel with a gradient rim, two corner tints and light edges; no blur. Rim and tint colours are params.
- params: ring (number, default 1.5, 0..4); gloss (bool, default true); tintA (colour, default "rgba(200,200,200,0.24)"); tintB (colour, default "rgba(200,200,200,0.24)"); rim1 (colour, default "#ffffffdd"); rim2 (colour, default "#ffffff55"); rim3 (colour, default "#cfcfcfaa"); rim4 (colour, default "#bdbdbdcc"); rim5 (colour, default "#d9d9d9cc"); rim6 (colour, default "#ffffffaa"); distance (number, default 6, 0..14); blur (number, default 20, 0..40)
- materials: clear-glass

### dotted-list-panel  (library: outline-frame)
- tier: recipe
- what: Material: a list panel framed thick-over-thin on paper, display-face items split by dotted rules, the picked item italic with an ink bar.
- params: top (number, default 3, 1..8); bottom (number, default 1, 0..4); size (number, default 15, 11..20); bar (number, default 3, 1..6)
- materials: dotted-list-panel

### double-edge  (library: outline-frame)
- tier: recipe
- what: Material: a panel edged by one thick rule (double or solid) on a chosen side, or all round, with no radius or shadow.
- params: edge (enum, default "left", left|right|top|bottom|box); width (number, default 3, 1..8); style (enum, default "double", double|solid); titles (bool, default false); restorePad (bool, default false)
- materials: double-edge

### edge-cast
- tier: generator
- what: Material: a canvas-coloured panel docked to one edge that throws a long soft shadow away from that edge, rounded on its free corners.
- params: edge (enum, default "left", left|right|top|bottom); radius (number, default 22, 0..40); blur (number, default 24, 0..50); spread (number, default -12, -30..0); reach (number, default 8, 0..20)
- materials: edge-cast

### film-frame
- tier: recipe
- what: Material: a hairline-framed cell with a perforated rebate strip along its top and bottom edge, like a film frame.
- params: rebate (number, default 9, 4..18); hole (number, default 4, 2..8); pitch (number, default 14, 8..30); band (number, default 14, 0..40)
- materials: film-frame

### flat-fill  (library: flat-surface)
- tier: recipe
- what: Material: a flat colour fill from a palette role, no border, no shadow.
- params: fill (enum, default "primary", primary|secondary|accent|ink|canvas|line|muted|tint)
- materials: flat-fill

### flat-paper  (library: flat-surface)
- tier: recipe
- what: Material: a flat paper surface with no fill or shadow.
- params: fill (enum, default "none", none|canvas); padded (bool, default false)
- materials: flat-paper

### flat-skeleton
- tier: recipe
- what: Material: loading placeholders as still soft-hairline blocks with square corners (avatars stay round).
- materials: flat-skeleton

### glossy  (library: glossy)
- tier: generator
- what: Material: a solid role colour with a white gloss wash, a faint rim and a soft drop shadow.
- params: fill (enum, default "primary", primary|secondary|accent|ink); gloss (number, default 0.2, 0..0.6); x (number, default 3, 0..10); y (number, default 5, 0..12); blur (number, default 9, 0..24); radius (number, default -1, -1..999)
- materials: glossy
